title: MASCOT: Multi-Agent Socio-Collaborative Companion Systems
abstract: arXiv:2601.14230v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are emerging as promising socio-collaborative companions for emotional and cognitive support. However, existing systems frequently suffer from persona collapse, where agents revert to generic, homogenized assistant behaviors, and social sycophancy, where agents produce redundant, non-constructive dialogue. We propose MASCOT, a multi-agent framework for multi-perspective socio-collaborative companions. MASCOT introduces a novel bi-level optimization strategy to harmonize individual and collective behaviors: 1) Persona-Aware Behavioral Alignment, an RLAIF-driven pipeline that finetunes individual agents for agent-specific identities; and 2) Collaborative Dialogue Optimization, a group-level adaptation process that promotes complementary, diverse, and productive discourse. We evaluate MASCOT using human-grounded contexts drawn across both in-domain and out-of-domain (OOD) settings against state-of-the-art

translated_title: MASCOT：多智能体社会协作伴侣系统
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统（MAS）正在成为有前景的社会协作伴侣，可为用户提供情感和认知支持。然而，现有系统经常遭受“人格崩塌”问题，即智能体退化为通用的、同质化的助手行为；以及“社交谄媚”问题，即智能体产生冗余的、非建设性的对话。我们提出了MASCOT，一个面向多视角社会协作伴侣的多智能体框架。MASCOT引入了一种新颖的双层优化策略来协调个体行为和集体行为：1）人格感知行为对齐，这是一个由RLAIF（基于AI反馈的强化学习）驱动的流程，用于微调各个智能体以获得其特定的身份特征；以及2）协作对话优化，这是一个组级别的适应过程，可促进互补、多样且富有成效的话语交流。我们在领域内和领域外（OOD）设置的基于真实人类的情境中，将MASCOT与最先进的方法进行了对比评估。
tldr: MASCOT提出了一种新颖的双层优化策略——通过人格感知行为对齐（RLAIF微调个体身份）和协作对话优化（组级别适应），解决了多智能体伴侣系统中的人格崩塌和社交谄媚问题，实现互补、多样且富有成效的多视角社会协作陪伴。
en_tdlr: MASCOT introduces a novel bi-level optimization strategy—combining Persona-Aware Behavioral Alignment (RLAIF-driven individual finetuning) and Collaborative Dialogue Optimization (group-level adaptation)—to address persona collapse and social sycophancy in multi-agent systems, enabling complementary, diverse, and productive socio-collaborative companionship.
